data.camera: cowboy shot, standing at snowy Wall crenellations in a coronation gown and cloak
data.description: 【希斯特里亚 · 雪原眺望】落雪的城墙垛口，希斯特里亚披着加冕的白袍与斗篷望向墙外的雪原，金发上落满细雪，王冠在阴沉的雪光里静静发光——「墙外的雪，和墙内一样白。总有一天，大家都能一起看到。」
data.promptProse: Historia looks beyond snow-covered Wall crenellations in her white coronation gown and cloak, wearing the crown with dark closed boots beneath the hem. Fine snow settles on her blonde hair in the cowboy view. The parapet leads toward an open snowfield outside the Wall. Gloomy reflected snow light softly defines the white layers and gold crown, leaving the spaces between stone battlements darker against the distant pale ground.
data.title: 希斯特里亚 · 雪原眺望
